attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on CentOS Stream 10, secured with a dedicated cluster CA. All replication traffic uses TLS (sslmode=verify-full) and pg_hba.conf on node1 restricts replication connections to hostssl with clientcert=verify-full for the 'replicator' role, so only peers with a certificate signed by the cluster CA can replicate. Verified negative cases (no cert, and a non-CA self-signed cert) are rejected. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving boot-id change and full data/replication recovery after each restart, including a live write propagating to both standbys post-restart.
